same_as probably includes non-Twain 998 cluster matches that are on the page: 'Clemens, Olivia Langdon LC|n 89103996', 'Clemens, Olivia Langdon NKC|jx20050822002' and 'Karłowicz, Mieczysław PLWABN|9810596485605606' (VIAF joint-author or title matches to other people). 47 same_as values came from page text, and that is about the whole 998 list.

label_issues: access 'plain HTTP + page text for 146/147 values' is misleading. The only structured value is the chrome 'en', so the record content came entirely from page text and access should read 'page text only'. format_family 'ad-hoc JSON/XML' should be 'library format' (MARC 21 in VIAF JSON), and that data went unparsed. This is the 'MARC-as-JSON unparsed' error class.
notable: The 678 note gives birth place 'Florida' and death place 'Redding', both correct. LNB|LNC10-000002679 is clustered here, but LNB|LNC10-000075960 is only in the unclustered 996 list.

missing: Nothing substantial. Works reach the cap and the manifestations' cocreators are captured.
label_issues: A large part of the profile is a mirror of Wikidata: the json:bindings.* values (dateOfBirth, placeOfBirth, occupation list, ISNI, image) and the page's 'Wikidane' block (birth/death date and place, pseudonym, 'Mark Twain House' residence, VIAF 16444837). The site shows these from Wikidata. wd_match 11 is therefore partly Wikidata agreeing with itself, and the descriptive/uniqueness figures count Wikidata's data as the library's. The library's own authority record only has 1835, 1910, gender, language, occupation 'Pisarze amerykańscy', field 'Literatura', variants and sources.
notable: There are duplicate cocreators with different dates in the site data ('Tarnowski, Marceli (1899-ok. 1942)' and '(1899-ok. 1944)'), which is a site data quality problem.

notable: The RDF parse ingested triples about the vocabulary (rdf:CompoundLiteral, skosxl:Label nodes) as if they described the entity.
